newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Result of bid for 20 pct of BFE on Dec 10.
newsitem.headline: Result of bid for 20 pct of BFE on Dec 10.

text.p: The Lisbon bourse will hold a special session on December 10 to announce the results of a bid by Banco Portugues de Investimento (BPI) for 20 percent of the capital of Banco de Fomento e Exterior (BFE), the bourse's official bulletin said.
The price offered in the bid for 25,203,100 shares is 2,615 escudos per share and the subscription period ends on December 4.
BPI acquired a 65 percent stake in BPI at the same price in August.
BFE shares closed on Lisbon bourse yesterday at 2,598 escudos and BPI closed at 1,825 escudos.
